We need to propose a retrosynthesis route (max 3 steps) to target SMILES: COc1cccc(NC(=O)c2nnn(Cc3ccc(CN4CC(F)C4)cc3)c2N)c1

We need leaves commercially available chemicals, total price <= $9999. We don't have price data, but we can assume typical small molecules are buyable. Need to construct route using templates.

We have template ID 647549 from earlier search: seems to be amide bond formation between an amine and carboxylic acid? The retro_smarts_template shows product is amide linking an aniline (aryl amine) to a heterocycle carboxylic acid? Let's examine: retro_smarts_template: '[O;D1;H0:2]=[C;H0;D3;+0:1](-[NH;D2;+0:8]-[c:9])-[c:3]1:[#7;a:4]:[#7;a:5]:[#7;a:6]:[c:7]:1>>O-[C;H0;D3;+0:1](=[O;D1;H0:2])-[c:3]1:[#7;a:4]:[#7;a:5]:[#7;a:6]:[c:7]:1.[NH2;D1;+0:8]-[c:9]'

So retro: product is amide linking an aniline (c9) to heterocycle (c3-7). Reactants: carboxylic acid (O-C=O) attached to heterocycle, and amine (NH2) attached to aromatic ring.

Thus we can disconnect the amide bond between the aniline (aryl amine) and the heterocycle carbonyl.

Our target: COc1cccc(NC(=O)c2nnn(Cc3ccc(CN4CC(F)C4)cc3)c2N)c1

So we have an aniline (aryl with OMe) attached via NH-CO- to heterocycle (c2nnn...). So step 1: disconnection to aniline fragment: COc1cccc(NH2)c1 (p-anisidine?) Actually the aniline is COc1cccc(NH-CO-...). The amine part is the aniline with OMe at para? The SMILES: COc1cccc(NC(=O)... )c1. So the aniline is 4-methoxyaniline (p-anisidine). That's commercially available.

The acid fragment: c2nnn(Cc3ccc(CN4CC(F)C4)cc3)c2N with a carbonyl attached to it (carboxylic acid). So the heterocycle is a 1,2,4-triazine? Actually nnn ring. The fragment is a 1,2,4-triazine with an amino substituent and a side chain Cc3... So the acid is (c2nnn(... )c2N)C(=O)OH. So we need to get that acid.

We can further disconnect the side chain Cc3ccc(CN4CC(F)C4)cc3 attached to the triazine via a methylene (CH2). That side chain is a phenyl with a side chain CN4CC(F)C4 (a fluorinated azetidine? Actually N4CC(F)C4 is a 3-member? N4CC(F)C4 is a azetidine? N4CC(F)C4 is a four-membered ring with F on carbon. So it's a N-alkylated azetidine.

Thus we can consider disconnection of the C-CH2 bond between triazine carbon and phenyl (aryl-CH2). That is a C-C bond formation (alkylation). Could be via SN2 of benzyl halide with heterocycle anion? Or via Suzuki? But we need a template.

Search for templates that break a C-C bond between heteroaryl and phenyl? Use functional_groups_broken maybe "C-C single bond". Let's search.
